Spatio-temporal Gaussian Tracking (SGT) is a method for modeling surface dynamics in dynamic scenes by tracking the attribute shift of each Gaussian at time $t$ using a deformation field $D(\mu, t)$, allowing the rendering of deformed Gaussians $G_t$ [S1, unofficial].

The claim accurately reflects the content of Source [S1]. The source explicitly describes a method (EndoGaussian) that models surface dynamics by tracking attribute shifts using a deformation field D(µ, t) to render deformed Gaussians Gt. It details the decomposition of D into E and F, the specific structure of E (HexPlane decomposition), and the composition of Gt involving position, rotation, scaling, and opacity, while noting that SH coefficients are not modeled for deformation. All specific facts mentioned in the claim are present in the evidence.
